method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse paraphrase of every definition and proposition, reconstruction of the concatenated transitivity derivation, replay of the compactness proof, and exact formula, macro, token, label, reference-option and identifier comparison; no independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Axiomatic derivability, theoremhood and consistency; reflexivity, monotonicity and transitivity; the inconsistency characterization; and proof-theoretic compactness.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Proof-theoretic notions are defined through derivability rather than semantic satisfaction. A is derivable from Gamma exactly when a Gamma-derivation ends in A; A is a theorem when derived from the empty set; Gamma is consistent exactly when it does not derive falsity.
samples.checks: The FOL/PL validity-versus-tautology branch, entailment and satisfiability list, soundness/completeness link, both Proves notations, empty-set condition and consistency polarity are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Reflexivity follows because A alone is a derivation from any Gamma containing A. Monotonicity follows because a derivation from Gamma remains a derivation from any superset Delta. Transitivity states that Gamma deriving A and A together with Delta deriving B imply Gamma union Delta derives B.
samples.checks: Membership, subset and union directions are unchanged, and the formula and derivation token counts remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For transitivity, prepend a Gamma-derivation ending in A to a derivation of B from {A} union Delta. Any later B_i line equal to A can use the same justification as the new earlier A_k line, so the combined sequence derives B from Gamma union Delta. The two stated chaining consequences follow.
samples.checks: The A- and B-sequence order, indices k and l, the displayed concatenated sequence, every axiom/member/rule alternative, and the source's exact B_i and A_k formulas remain intact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Gamma is inconsistent exactly when it derives every formula. The proof is left as an exercise, followed by separate protected first-order and propositional problem references.
samples.checks: The universal direction, Exercise placeholder, FOL/notFOL tags, three-part reference options and proposition identifier are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Proof-theoretic compactness says any derivation from Gamma uses only a finite subset Gamma_0, and consistency of every finite subset implies consistency of Gamma. The first clause selects the Gamma-members among the finite derivation lines; the second is its contrapositive at falsity.
samples.checks: Both proposition items and proof items preserve their direction, finiteness, subset relation, finite sequence, last-line identity, three-way justification alternatives and special case A identical to falsity.

source_observations: The transitivity proof is specific to axiomatic line sequences: it concatenates two finite derivations and reuses the justification of the first derivation's last A-line.
The compactness proof uses only those derivation lines that belong to Gamma as the finite premise subset; logical axioms and rule-generated lines are not added to Gamma_0.
The unit contains two enumerated proposition items, two enumerated proof items and two tagged problem environments in both source and target.
No formula, macro, token, label, identifier, reference option or proof condition was changed.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The exact Marathi compounds for proof-theoretic notions, soundness and compactness remain open to expert correction under the existing terminology ledger.
The source leaves the inconsistency characterization as an exercise, and the translation retains that omission.
